rewrite/src/clients/tui/presentation/com.reason: Verbatim copy of legacy source/components/message/CommandMessage.tsx: tool rows match legacy by construction; splitting it would reintroduce a rewrite to prove. Four lines are the port exception that reads a live render's measured elapsed time (live-tool-age.ts).
Verbatim copy of legacy source/components/message/command-message-helpers.ts, the parsers and labels CommandMessage and its renderers share.

rewrite/src/clients/tui/menus/menu-contr.reason: Verbatim port of source/components/input/menu-controller.ts (the legacy menu stack); kept whole so it stays diffable against the legacy oracle.

rewrite/src/clients/tui/menus/use-provid.reason: Verbatim port of source/hooks/use-provider-selection.ts (the legacy /providers manager state machine); kept whole so it stays diffable against the legacy oracle.

rewrite/src/clients/tui/menus/use-subage.reason: Port of source/hooks/use-subagent-pool-selection.ts with only imports changed; kept whole so it stays diffable against the legacy oracle.

rewrite/src/clients/tui/session.tsx.reason: The session wires the composer to the ported legacy menu stack (useMenuStack, double-Escape) and routes every report into the transcript as legacy's addSystemMessage does; that wiring closes over submit, rewind and the viewport, declared later in the same component, so moving it out would add ref plumbing rather than a job seam. The composer's JSX also sits inside ComposerWidth (legacy InputBox's width-0 first frame), which only wraps it, and the command path routes a legacy clear-and-switch confirmation to the plan-toggle hook. The approval panel's Escape adds legacy's Stopped line through the viewport (one prop). The menu stack's first-run setup prompt sits under the live divider as legacy BottomArea places it (one line; the gate itself lives in menus/use-first-run-setup.ts).

rewrite/src/clients/tui/approval-prompt..reason: Verbatim port of legacy source/components/prompt/ApprovalPrompt.tsx (every approval and ask_user layout and key path); only its data access changed, so it matches legacy by construction.

rewrite/src/engine/turn-tools.ts.reason: One per-call Execution record carries a call's planning, admission, interaction answers and settlement; the chosen approval grant rides it like the batch-asked answer, so splitting would pass that record across files.
